title: Large-text users and Mobile shoppers can't pick a size: 'Size' gets rage clicks and Add to Cart is pressed without a size

quotes: There's a 'Size' label but no sizes I can choose.
It keeps saying select a size but I don't see any sizes.
I tapped the size box but nothing opens. I can't pick a size.

suggestedFix: Show every size as a visible button that works on tap and without hover, and say which size is missing when Add to Cart is pressed.

title: Applying a promo code wipes the shipping form: the next submit fails on 5 fields

quotes: Now the shipping form. Filling in my address.

suggestedFix: Keep the shipping form's values when a promo code is applied (don't reset or re-mount the form), and keep the code applied.
